snippet.title: Project Motor Racing | V8 Power Pack - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Turn up the volume, and make it loud!

The V8 Power Pack for Project Motor Racing is available now.

This pack delivers nine legendary V8 race cars across three classes, spanning modern Australian touring-car muscle, current American machinery, and the raw roots of historic US road racing, all racing together at Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta.

Across all three classes, the appeal is simple: big V8 power, rear-wheel drive, and no traction control, ABS, or electronic aids. The pack takes players from the heroic days of American muscle-car road racing through purpose-built modern USV8 machinery and into contemporary AUS V8 Evo competition – all with the driver firmly at the centre of the experience.

Historic US V8:
► 1971 AMC Javelin
► 1969 Chevrolet Camaro Z/28
► 1970 Ford Mustang Boss 302
► 1970 Plymouth Barracuda

US V8
► 2022 Chevrolet Camaro
► 2022 Dodge Challenger
► 2022 Ford Mustang

AUS V8 EVO:
► 2023 Chevrolet Camaro AU
► 2023 Ford Mustang AU

Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta
This circuit is 4 KM (2.5 MI) of blind crests, elevation changes, fast esses and heavy braking zones carved into the Georgia hills. It’s the sort of circuit where fast cars feel faster, old cars feel wilder, and one small mistake has plenty of opportunity to become a large one.


Available now for Year 1 Season Pass holders and as a stand-alone DLC.
